name: @cocreate/actions
description: Chain multiple component executions to generate your desired logic, when one action is complete next one will start. The sequence goes until all actions have been completed. Vanilla javascript, easily configured using HTML5 attributes and/or JavaScript API.
author: CoCreate LLC

attributes.name: actions
attributes.description: Runs actions in order when the element is clicked. Names may refer to built-in actions or actions registered by modules.

attributes.name: actions-prevent-default
attributes.description: Set to the string "false" to allow the click's default browser behavior; otherwise Actions prevents it.

actions.name: event
actions.description: Waits for the named event on the action element before continuing.

actions.name: timeout
actions.description: Waits for a positive delay before continuing.

actions.name: action
actions.description: Clicks matching elements and waits for their action chains to complete.

actions.name: submit
actions.description: Dispatches a cancelable submit event for the closest form and waits for its submitted event.

actions.name: disabled
actions.description: Toggles the closest button's disabled attribute. If the chain aborts, Actions re-enables a button it disabled.

actions.name: elementMethod
actions.description: For other action names, queries matching elements and invokes a same-named method on each element when available.

registeredActions.description: Other modules register actions through the JavaScript API. Dotted syntax supplies a method to the registered action callback.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Registers one or more custom actions. Duplicate names are ignored.
methods.completion: A callback must call end() or continue() to proceed, or abort(reason) to stop. A rejected callback promise aborts; a fulfilled promise alone does not continue.

hooks.name: href
hooks.description: Completion handler called after a successful chain. It can be supplied through CoCreate.actions.href or replaced on the default exported API object; otherwise Actions uses its built-in href handler.

events.name: actionsEnd
events.description: Dispatched when the full chain completes successfully.

events.name: actionsAbort
events.description: Dispatched when the full chain aborts.

events.name: action endEvent
events.description: Dispatched by a registered action's end(detail); it bubbles and includes element, form, action metadata, and the supplied detail.
